title: Your account
description: Your details, how you sign in to BoxLead and your open sessions.

language.description: Choose the language you see BoxLead in.

name.title: Name
name.description: How we show you in BoxLead and in the emails we send you.
name.failed: We couldn't save your name. Please try again.

email.title: Email
email.fromProvider: It comes from the account you sign in with, so you change it there.
email.description: It's the one you sign in with and where we write to you.
email.help: We'll send a link to the new email. Until you open it you keep signing in with {{email}}.
email.pending: We sent a link to {{pending}} to confirm the change. Until you open it you keep signing in with {{email}}.
email.failed: We couldn't request the change. Please try again.

password.title: Password
password.none: Your account has no password. You sign in with the same button you used to create it.
password.description: When you change it we sign out your other devices.
password.saved: You changed your password and we signed out your other devices.
password.tooShort: The new password must have at least {{min}} characters.
password.failed: We couldn't change your password. Please try again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Sign out of every device where you signed in, this one included. You'll need to sign in again.
sessions.confirmText: You'll be signed out of BoxLead everywhere, here too.
sessions.failed: We couldn't close your sessions. Please try again.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: We delete your connections, leads, conversations and agents, and they can't be recovered. We only keep what the law requires, like invoices and payments.
deletion.connections: We delete your connections with Meta, WhatsApp and Mercado Libre.
deletion.data: We delete your leads, conversations, categories and agents.
deletion.kept: We keep invoices, payments and terms acceptances because the law requires it.
deletion.reauthRequired: You need to sign in again with your provider right before deleting your account.
deletion.subscriptionOpen: Cancel your subscription first. Then you'll be able to delete your account.
deletion.manual: This account is closed by hand. Email us at {{email}} from the account email.
deletion.failed: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how you hear about new leads and conversations waiting for you.
notifications.panelDescription: We let you know when a new lead comes in or when a conversation needs a person. Notifications never show names or messages.
notifications.saveFailed: We couldn't save the change. Please try again.
notifications.newLeadEmail: Email when a new lead comes in
notifications.newLeadEmailHelp: We group leads from a few minutes into a single email, with the count per channel.
notifications.handoffEmail: Email when the agent hands a conversation to a person
notifications.handoffEmailHelp: We write to you when a conversation needs you to reply.
notifications.browser: Browser alerts while the app is open
notifications.browserHelp: We show an alert on screen and add the count to the tab title.

system.title: System notifications
system.needsBrowser: They only show up with browser alerts turned on.
system.defaultHelp: We notify you with a system notification when BoxLead is open and you're in another window. Your browser will ask for permission.
system.grantedHelp: We notify you with a system notification when BoxLead is open and you're in another window, without names or messages.
system.deniedHelp: To turn them on, allow BoxLead notifications in your browser's site settings.
system.unsupportedHelp: This browser doesn't show system notifications. You'll still see alerts inside the app.

notice.newLeadOn_one: A new lead came in on {{channel}}
